events.verdict: Brown (BOS) reaches in and avoids making contact with Daniels (ATL). Horford (BOS) places a forearm against Daniels' body, but the contact is marginal.
Brown (BOS) legally contests Johnson's (ATL) driving shot attempt.
Brown (BOS) moves alongside of Johnson's (ATL) path to the basket and the body contact is marginal.
Johnson (ATL) remains in bounds before making the pass to Nance Jr. (ATL).
Horford (BOS) extends his arms into Johnson's (ATL) path and delivers contact.
Brown (BOS) establishes himself in a screening position in Wallace's (ATL) path and does not deliver contact.
Holiday (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position during Daniels' (ATL) drive to the basket.
Okongwu (ATL) tips the ball in and any contact by Brown (BOS) and Holiday (BOS) is incidental.
Daniels (ATL) commits a take foul on Brown (BOS).
Tatum (BOS) backs up as the pass is thrown and although Wallace (ATL) has a hand placed on his arm, he does not pull him to affect his ability to receive the pass.

events.verdict: Holiday's (BOS) inbound pass goes out of bounds.
Brown (BOS) deflects the throw-in and avoids stepping out of bounds. There is an inadvertent whistle when Brown has control of the ball, and therefore Boston is given possession when play resumes.
Johnson (ATL) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
